items.title: Where CVX's $119 billion Of Shareholder Cash Came From
items.summary: A torrent of cash returned to Chevron owners has powered market-beating returns, but it raises a sharp question about where the energy giant goes from here.

items.title: Exxon Gains 2% While Washington Leaves It Outside $4 Gas Talks
items.summary: Crude's return above $90 boosts cash flow, but Exxon's White House exclusion creates a new political discount.

items.title: Can Refining & Logistics Projects Drive PARR's Next Growth Phase?
items.summary: Par Pacific focuses on smaller refining and logistics projects targeting low-20% unlevered returns to drive growth.

items.title: Can Phillips 66 Reach Its $5.50 Refining Cost Target in 2027?
items.summary: PSX targets refining costs of $5.50 per barrel in 2027 as more than 200 initiatives drive efficiency, reliability and lower expenses.

items.title: Energy stocks rally as fresh U.S.-Iran attacks drive oil prices higher
items.summary: Investing.com -- U.S.-listed energy stocks climbed in premarket trading Monday, tracking a more than 2% jump in oil prices after American forces struck an Iranian island in the Strait of Hormuz and Tehran retaliated.

items.title: Trump to Discuss High Fuel Prices With Oil Refiners Next Week
items.summary: President Donald Trump is set to meet with US oil refining executives as he confronts persistently high gasoline prices stoked by the war in Iran.

items.title: The Number ExxonMobil No Longer Puts In Front Of Its Results
items.summary: Management's own scorecard still leads with dollars, but the return measure that used to sit beside it was absent again, and that changes what a holder is actually betting on.

items.title: Chevron Could Be Big Winner If Venezuela Pulls Out of OPEC
items.summary: Venezuela is edging away from OPEC, U.S. companies are circling its vast untapped oil fields, and one American energy giant already has a foot in the door before the bidding even begins.
